title: E0125: Open redirect via header
plain_english: Redirecting users with `header("Location: ...")` to a URL taken from user input without validation can create an open redirect vulnerability.
why_matters: Open redirects can be abused for: - Phishing, by making malicious links appear to come from a trusted domain - Bypassing expectations around post-login redirects - Redirecting users to sites that attempt to steal credentials or deliver malicious content
